name: scenario_b_night
title: Night battle at the torches and the temple
about: Night. From RTS heights: the approach over the east ring road towards the lit temple (the blue column with its Electrobot and MLRS below), a wide pass along the road over the fight at the torch pole where the red squads attack north and fight back, a high look from the west over the fight to the campfire and the pyramid's fire bowls (a tank blows up, the MLRS salvos land), and a slow push over the gateway to the whole temple in its fire light (the last framing kept as it was), where the red laser squad attacks west and fires across the frame at a blue squad coming from the west, while three red mechs come up from the south to help.

shot 4: the gateway torches from RTS height, a slow push to the kept last framing: the red lasers fire across it at the blue flank coming from the west (lower left)
